links.outcome: LLM risk prediction performance when input variables were omitted from the prompt
links.effect: With a few variables omitted, GPT-3.5 prediction performance was preserved, especially when physical measurement data were left out.
links.quote: The additional analysis of limited variables using GPT-3·5 indicated that ChatGPT’s prediction performance was preserved despite the omission of a few variables in the prompt, especially without physical measurement data

screen.reason: The study benchmarks zero-shot/prompted LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, Bard) against a standard clinical risk calculator (Framingham Risk Score) for predicting cardiovascular disease risk using retrospective cohort datasets (UK Biobank and KoGES).
